text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "Services linguistiques centraux, Section allemande", "gist": "German Section of the Federal Chancellery's Central Language Services"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "La Section allemande veille à l’intelligibilité des textes officiels et contribue au bon fonctionnement de la communication plurilingue des autorités.", "gist": "The German Section ensures intelligibility of official texts and supports multilingual communication of authorities"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Commission interne de rédaction (CIR)", "gist": "Internal Drafting Commission (CIR)"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "la Section allemande veille à ce que les textes de loi soient formulés de manière précise, claire, cohérente et aussi simple que possible", "gist": "The German Section must ensure laws are formulated precisely, clearly, coherently, and as simply as possible"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "elle s’assure de la concordance des versions dans les trois langues officielles", "gist": "It ensures consistency of versions across the three official languages"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Elle examine encore d’autres documents des autorités, tels que des rapports ou avis du Conseil fédéral, pour qu’ils soient compréhensibles et de bonne facture sur le plan linguistique.", "gist": "It also reviews other authority documents like Federal Council reports or opinions to ensure they are linguistically comprehensible and well-crafted"}]}
